# Follow-through notes (copy to videos/<slug>/notes.md; `tools/audit.js` fails without these three sections)

## Promise ledger
| Promise (hook, "See, X had a problem", every question asked) | Paid off at |
|---|---|
| "Why do we X?" | the mirror line |
| the character's problem | the closing line, WITH a reason |
| the belief | the test that breaks it |
| the re-hook question | the best idea |
| "Does it fit?" | the evidence lines (each bridged) |
| the open mystery | said openly ("Nobody knows why") |

## Causal chain (every link SPOKEN)
belief → test → so it's not that → best idea → everyday comparison that says why → evidence 1 (bridge) → evidence 2 (so what) → not settled → best guess → the character's problem closed with a reason

## Retell test (3 sentences, written from the narration alone)
1. <what people think, and the test that broke it>. 2. <the best idea and the evidence, because ...>. 3. <what is still unknown and what the viewer can do>.
